Hi Lisa / Tom —

Thanks for the clear questions. Short answers below — happy to expand or hop on a quick follow-up call with your security team.

SOC 2 / HIPAA
- Redwood has an active SOC 2 Type II report covering our control plane, onboarding, identity & access management, and the hosted API surface. The inference runtime on Dedicated instances is included under our scoped systems for the report; we can provide the SOC 2 Type II report under NDA.
- For HIPAA: Redwood supports a BAA for customers processing PHI. We have a standard BAA template we prefer to start with; happy to share. Operationally, for the pilot we recommend using Dedicated capacity with customer-managed VPCs where required.

Telemetry / Console / Cookies
- Product telemetry we collect: service-level metrics (latency, error rates), anonymized usage patterns (API endpoint usage counts, model selection), and aggregated billing/usage metrics. By default we do NOT ingest or store raw customer prompt or response text in analytics pipelines; logs that contain content are access-controlled and stored per customer isolation policies.
- Identifiers: telemetry events include account_id (internal numeric id) and route_id for routing. We can mask or omit account-level identifiers on request for the pilot. We do not include user emails or raw PHI in telemetry.
- Cookies & third-party analytics: our docs site (docs.redwood.inference) uses a minimal analytics configuration (Matomo self-hosted) for aggregate page metrics; we do not load third-party marketing pixels on the console. Cookie lifetimes are short (session or 30 days for non-essential). We publish a cookie policy on the docs site — I’ve linked the internal summary below and will ask our Docs team to provide the public link.

Deliverables / Next steps from Redwood
- I’ll upload the SOC 2 Type II summary (and full report under NDA) to the shared drive.
- We can fill out the vendor questionnaire you attached; please confirm if any sections require providing screenshots or sample console telemetry events.
- I’ll prepare a one-page telemetry/cookie FAQ that you can share with Privacy.

If you want to schedule a 30-min follow-up with our security team and SEs, I’m free Wed/Thu afternoon PT.

Thanks —
Monica Patel
Security & Trust | Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.inference
